//: Secrets are deliberately empty here and are never committed with a value. They are supplied by dotnet user-secrets in Development and by environment variables in Production. See docs/api-windows-service.md.

Upload.//: Largest accepted manual notice upload, in bytes. Anything larger is refused with 413. Default 32 MB.

Ops.//: The /ops deploy-proof page. Paths are where the two services are installed on the host, reported on the cards. DeployHistoryPath is the file the deploy workflows append to, tailed as the Deploy Actions section. ProbeTimeoutMilliseconds bounds the database check so a database that is down cannot stall the page.
